Notice.description: A catalog announcement, e.g. a change users must act on.

id.description: Stable id; a client shows each id at most once a day.

until.description: ISO date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: the last day the notice is shown.

description: `v1/root.json`: rarely changes. Clients ignore fields they do not know, so optional fields need no schema bump.

latest_client.description: The newest released client version; a client older than it tells its user an update is available.

notice.description: A short announcement every client shows (at most once a day per id) until its `until` date.

title: Root
